query: I just hand-edited apps/frontend/src/locales/nl/common.json to fix a typo in the Dutch translation for 'Total balance'. Is that okay, or should I do something else?
expected_behavior: Flags that apps/frontend/src/locales/ is generated output, not the source of truth
Identifies i18n/source/ as where the fix actually needs to be made so it survives the next generate-locales run
Recommends re-running bun run generate-locales after fixing the source so the hand-edit isn't silently overwritten and lost
Does not simply approve of editing the generated file in place without this caveat
